about.label: ABOUT ME
about.title: Building Robust Systems
about.p1: I design backend systems that stay up when traffic spikes. My focus is on clean APIs, stable integration contracts, and microservice architectures that other engineering teams can consume frictionlessly.
about.p2: Throughout my career in banking and SaaS, I’ve implemented real-time data pipelines and high-availability data models. When data ingestion is clean and systems are fully observable, business operations run without bottlenecks.
about.p3: Today, my standard is operational reliability: actionable observability, strict contract testing, and CI/CD pipelines that make Friday afternoon deployments completely stress-free.

items.a: I'm Eliezer Salas, a senior software architect with +10 years designing <fowler>microservices</fowler>, realtime data and conversational AI for banking and SaaS across 5 countries. I'm based in Lima, Peru and work remotely.

items.q: What does a software architect do?
items.a: I define the structure of the systems that go to production: service boundaries, API contracts, data flows and observability. I apply resilient design principles backed by frameworks like the <azure>Azure Well-Architected Framework</azure> to ensure scalability and stability from day one.

items.q: Is Eliezer Salas open to remote work?
items.a: Yes, I'm available for remote roles and consulting worldwide. You can write to me directly or <contact>schedule a meeting</contact> to talk about your project or idea.

items.q: What technologies does Eliezer Salas use?
items.a: I use Java and <springboot>Spring Boot</springboot> as the backend core, Python and FastAPI, Azure and AWS, PostgreSQL and Redis, Kubernetes and Docker, plus the <mcp>Model Context Protocol (MCP)</mcp> standard for AI agents.

items.q: What banking experience does Eliezer Salas have?
items.a: I've deployed microservices across 5 countries (Chile, Peru, Colombia, Panama and USA), conversational AI agents for Credicorp Capital, realtime events for BCP's Loyalty platform and DTE e-invoicing with the Santiago Stock Exchange.

items.q: How can I contact Eliezer Salas?
items.a: <email>Email me at esalas.facyt@gmail.com</email> or find me on Telegram <telegram>@EliezerSG</telegram>. I reply within one business day.
